cases.expected: 注册后使用新用户名和密码登录，响应重定向到博客首页（/），且会话中保存了该用户，页面显示已登录状态（如出现用户名或退出登录入口）。
preconditions: 已安装 Flask 及项目依赖（pip install -e .）
已初始化数据库（flask --app flaskr init-db）
测试使用 Flask 测试客户端，不依赖外部网络
cases.script_content:
# generated by aitest
import os
import uuid

import pytest

from flaskr import create_app


@pytest.fixture()
def app(tmp_path):
    app = create_app({
        "TESTING": True,
        "DATABASE": os.path.join(tmp_path, "test.sqlite"),
        "SECRET_KEY": "test",
    })
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    yield app


@pytest.fixture()
def client(app):
    return app.test_client()


def test_register_then_login(client):
    username = "user_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
    password = "secret123"

    resp = client.post("/auth/register", data={"username": username, "password": password})
    assert resp.status_code == 302
    assert "/auth/login" in resp.headers["Location"]

    resp = client.post("/auth/login", data={"username": username, "password": password})
    assert resp.status_code == 302
    assert resp.headers["Location"] == "/"

    resp = client.get("/")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.get_data(as_text=True)
    assert username in body
    assert "Log Out" in body or "Logout" in body
steps: 创建 Flask 测试客户端
POST /auth/register 提交唯一用户名与密码
POST /auth/login 提交相同用户名与密码
GET / 检查响应状态与页面内容

# generated by aitest
import os
import uuid

import pytest

from flaskr import create_app


@pytest.fixture()
def app(tmp_path):
    app = create_app({
        "TESTING": True,
        "DATABASE": os.path.join(tmp_path, "test.sqlite"),
        "SECRET_KEY": "test",
    })
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    yield app


@pytest.fixture()
def client(app):
    return app.test_client()


def test_login_wrong_password(client):
    username = "user_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
    client.post("/auth/register", data={"username": username, "password": "secret123"})

    resp = client.post("/auth/login", data={"username": username, "password": "wrongpass"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.get_data(as_text=True)
    assert "Incorrect password" in body

    resp = client.get("/")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert "Log In" in resp.get_data(as_text=True)

GET / 确认仍为未登录状态
